summary: Keep the existing Search by name action available in the native sale scanner's Suspense loading state. It invokes the same scanner cancellation and search-focus callback while the lazy camera is pending.
noAssistantImpact: A mobile local-draft recovery control only. Existing form_only scanner classification, Catalog read commands, permissions, sale confirmation, assistant/channel support and rollouts are unchanged. No sale, payment, stock, native dependency or provider effect is added.

After repair: all eight child cases / 21 assertions pass; exact JUnit wrapper and model pass 4 tests / 24 outer assertions. Fallback closes scanning, requests search focus and adds no item.
